question: Are you licensed and insured?
answer: Yes. MTC Renovations is fully insured and carries commercial general liability insurance. All of our tradespeople — electricians, plumbers, and HVAC technicians — are licensed Red Seal or Ontario-certified professionals. We are happy to provide proof of insurance upon request before any work begins. Hiring an uninsured contractor puts your home and finances at risk. With MTC, you are fully protected.
